name: Ghost
desc: A luminous vaporous specter, form built from glowing mist and dark hollow eyes, drifting and hem-rippling with a beat-synced bob, boo-lunge, and figure-eight orbit.

scale.doc: hero size vs design (~0.5*min(w,h) tall at 1)

pose.doc: auto follows act; idle=hover, dance=beat choreo, boo=lunge scare, orbit=figure-8 drift

style.doc: aesthetic: vapor=luminous mist no-outline, ink=sumi wash+hatch, xray=spectral radiograph (abstracted ribcage/skull), pixel=dot-matrix, neon=glow-rim, classic=flat sheet

act.doc: multi-minute pose program indexed by section
